summaries.en: The Linux kernel is the foundational open-source operating system core that powers everything from smartphones to supercomputers, solving the need for a free, customizable, and reliable OS. Its technical strength lies in its monolithic yet modular design, enabling efficient hardware interaction while allowing developers to add or remove features via loadable kernel modules. You can experiment by compiling a custom kernel with specific drivers, contributing patches to improve hardware support, or using it as a learning resource to understand low-level system programming and OS architecture.
summaries.zh: Linux内核是一个开源操作系统核心，为从智能手机到超级计算机的各种设备提供底层支持，解决了对自由、可定制且可靠操作系统的需求。其技术亮点在于采用单体式但模块化的架构，通过高效硬件交互和可加载内核模块机制，让开发者能灵活增减功能特性。实践中，你可以尝试编译带特定驱动的自定义内核、提交补丁改善硬件兼容性，或将其作为学习系统编程和操作系统设计的宝贵资源，深入理解计算机底层工作原理。

summaries.en: Rust is a systems programming language designed to solve memory safety and concurrency challenges that plague C/C++ development. Its innovative ownership system with borrow checking eliminates entire classes of bugs at compile time while maintaining C-level performance. Developers can use Rust to build everything from operating systems and web browsers to web servers and embedded systems, leveraging its strong type system and zero-cost abstractions for creating robust, high-performance applications.
summaries.zh: Rust 是一种系统编程语言，旨在解决 C/C++ 开发中常见的内存安全和并发难题。其创新的所有权系统与借用检查机制能在编译时消除整类错误，同时保持 C 语言级别的性能表现。通过独特的内存管理方式，Rust 无需垃圾回收即可确保内存安全，让开发者能够构建从操作系统、浏览器到网络服务器和嵌入式设备等各种高性能应用。你可以用它重写关键性能组件，或开发需要高可靠性的系统软件，体验无数据竞争并发的编程乐趣。
